title: 여신전문금융업법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Announcement of Distribution of Assets)

(1) The person entitled to exercise their rights under Article 26(1) shall, in accordance with Article 26(4), determine the reporting period, reporting method, and reporting location, and publicly announce this information in at least two nationally distributed daily newspapers.
1. Reporting Period: To be at least 2 weeks
2. Reporting Method: To specify that it can be done orally, in writing, by fax, or via information and communication networks.
3. Reporting Location: To be the person's head office or branch office.

(2) The announcement under (1) may include the date of repayment, the method of repayment, and any other relevant information regarding the repayment of the debt.
